answer: Proof of Stake enforces Sybil resistance by requiring validators to lock liquid assets proportional to their influence. This mechanism refracts the consensus through a capital-based prism, melting the attacker's fable of infinite scalability by demanding that every active identity represents a distinct, forfeitable stake. Any attempt to weaponize multiple identities triggers a violet penalty of slashed collateral, guaranteeing that the economic cost of malicious behavior fundamentally exceeds the marginal utility of the attack.
